author: Dalium
body:
A little while back I appealed to Avicus cause I love this server. I admitted to hacking and told them I was sorry. M37 replied with this...
Hello, 

Thank you for taking the time to appeal, however since you admit that you were in-fact cheating--the same length of ban applies to you as to anyone else who cheats on our server. 

This appeal is denied, you will need to wait around 4 more months to appeal.
Remember, if you want a chance at an appeal down the road, please do not ban evade (logging onto another account will impede your chances on getting unbanned).

Thank you for understanding,
-John
So if I lied and said I was falsely accused I would have more of a chance. Though in my appeal when I admit that I was hacking and said I was sorry, they took it as more evidence to keep me banned. Now I fully understand that hacking is not a joke and it is ban worthy, but to have them point to a hidden meaning that if I lied I would stand more of a chance, it's just intolerable! I would understand if my appeal was just not accepted, but to have them use that appeal and apology to further assure that I was hacking is just inhumane!!! This is one of my favorite servers with great games and people playing it, but to have staff that don't give a shit about its members will surely be the death of the server. You look 2 years back in 2014 and my little brother got banned for inviting some friends to play Mineplex. He was banned on the account of advertising, so woopdido, I thought every Minecraft multiplayer know of Mineplex. Avicus your server is great and has great games, but the reason it ain't growing in numbers is cause your banning every player that logs on for some dumb ass reason, and when they appeal you laugh in there faces.

Avicus start being good again.

title: Lie's to get me unbanned!

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

Some of the remarks that you made in your appeal are false,

"Avicus your server is great and has great games, but the reason it ain't growing in numbers is cause your banning every player that logs on for some dumb ass reason, and when they appeal you laugh in there faces."

> We ban players because they are breaking the rules, which isn't allowed. Also, I'd like to know your definition of a "dumb ass reason"

> "and when they appeal you laugh in there faces." I don't know where you heard this from, but its not true. When
     they appeal, we tell them what they did wrong and try to have a discussion if they see the ban as being invalid.

In your situation, you admitted to hacking. Just because you admitted doesn't change the fact that you actually hacked. You must face the consequences for your actions. Normally, you have to wait 6-8 months before making another appeal, but since you did admit, I will allow you to make another appeal in 4-6 months.

I'll leave this appeal open in case you want to discuss something.

replies.body: I do. My brother was banned because he was inviting friends to play mineplex with him. Mineplex is a server everybody knows of. The other thing is you shouldn't use my appeal to assure that I was hacking (or at least don't say it). I could have been unbanned by saying that it was some kind of glitch or I was falsely accused. Maybe I could say that the staff member who banned me knows me irl and hates me. Though I admit to what I did, and you don't see that as me being at least honest with you. Should I just start lying from now on?
